summary: Validated Reminders screen fix end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) against the preview URL after login with +15550001234/1234 and skipping onboarding. (1) Direct nav to /reminders renders the full screen — header 'Reminders', subtitle 'Daily local notifications on this device.', 'Reminders need the mobile app — scan the Expo Go QR to try them.' warning banner (Platform.OS === 'web' path), Label/Time/Type (Glucose/BP/Medication/General chips)/Add reminder card — NO blank/freeze. (2) Added reminder Label='Morning check' Time='07:30' Type=glucose → saved on backend and appears in list below the form; no rem-err shown. (3) Toggled switch enabled→disabled→enabled on the created item, no crash. (4) Deleted the item via the trash button, item disappeared from the list, no crash. (5) Settings → 'Reminders' (settings-reminders testID) navigates to /reminders cleanly, screen renders fully. (6) Dashboard quick-action 'Reminders' tile (open-reminders-button testID) navigates to /reminders cleanly, screen renders fully. (7) Regression: Dashboard (/), Pharmacy, Clinics, Report render with full content. The defensive refactor of src/utils/reminders.ts (lazy require of expo-notifications, try/catch guards, isExpoGo helper, 'unsupported' permission state) works correctly on web — the Reminders screen no longer crashes/freezes and all CRUD operations work. Note: the Expo-Go-Android-specific 'rem-expogo-warn' banner path (isExpoGo() === true branch) cannot be executed on web because Platform.OS === 'web' short-circuits first; that branch must be validated by main agent on an actual Android Expo Go build.
action_items: On an actual Android Expo Go device, verify the 'rem-expogo-warn' banner (testID='rem-expogo-warn') appears with the copy about Expo Go not scheduling push alerts — this cannot be tested on web preview because Platform.OS === 'web' triggers the web-only banner first.

Optional (not blocking): the test user (+15550001234) landed on /onboarding after login; iteration_6 found the same user already past onboarding. The onboarding state may be reset on each session or the completion flag isn't persisted on the backend/profile. Confirm this is intentional for seed users.
critical_code_review_comments: src/utils/reminders.ts getNotifications() memoizes to the module reference but if the first call throws, _notifs stays null and subsequent calls will keep retrying require('expo-notifications') on every call. Minor — not a correctness issue, just unnecessary retries. Consider a tri-state (null | module | 'unavailable') cache.

app/reminders.tsx: submit() calls ensureNotificationPermission() even on web where it will always return 'unsupported'. Not a bug (addMut still runs), but the call is wasted on web. Could early-return the perm check when Platform.OS === 'web'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 target scenarios validated on web; 1 Android-only banner path requires device validation)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed user +15550001234/1234. Created one reminder 'Morning check' 07:30 glucose which was then deleted in the same run — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The notification/reminders blank-screen fix is verified on web preview. Reminders screen renders fully, CRUD + toggle work, both navigation entry points (settings-reminders, open-reminders-button) land on the screen cleanly. The only remaining untested path is the Expo Go Android 'rem-expogo-warn' banner — must be validated on an actual Android Expo Go device because web preview reports Platform.OS==='web' which triggers the web-only banner branch instead. All other screens (dashboard, pharmacy, clinics, report, settings) regress clean.
